$comment: AUTHORED, NOT GENERATED, and deliberately not a `regen.ts` artifact: a schema regenerated from the projector would agree with whatever the projector wrote. Gated by `packages/engine/lint-component-docs.ts`, which validates `out/components/components.ai.json` against it with `json-schema-lite.ts`. Every object closes `additionalProperties`, so a field the projector adds, drops or renames fails until this schema and its `$id` version move with it.
title: Prism3 component documentation (components.ai.json)
description: Documentation for every registered component, projected from its definition: usage guidance, the accessibility contract, the code API and the decision surface for choosing a component. Brand-independent: a definition binds token names, and each brand's `<brand>.ai.json` resolves them. Field names mirror the definition schema, so `docs.usage` here is `docs.usage` in the definition.

$schema.description: The schema version this file follows. Equal to this schema's `$id`.

generated.description: Always true: every field is projected from a component definition, none is typed here.

engineVersion.description: The engine version that wrote this file.

note.description: A one-paragraph guide to the file, for a reader without this schema.

components.description: One entry per registered component, keyed by its id.

id.description: A component id: kebab-case, as registered.

texts.description: A list of prose entries. Empty when the definition carries none.

ids.description: A list of component ids. Empty when the definition carries none.

prop.description: One prop of the component's code API.

name.description: The prop name, as a code API spells it.

default.description: The default value. Absent when the prop has none.

required.description: Whether a consumer must set it. False when the definition does not say.

values.description: The allowed values, for an enum prop.

deprecated.description: Present and true when the prop is deprecated.

values.description: The axis values, in the definition's order.

kind.description: `runtime` when a live instance switches between the values; `authoring` when one is picked once and stays.

id.description: The component id. Equal to this entry's key.

aliases.description: Other names the component goes by, for search.

category.description: The grouping by purpose (action, form, feedback, …).

summary.description: The one-line summary, also written as the Figma component description.

description.description: What the component is and where it stops.

inherits.description: The component this one builds on. Absent when it stands alone.

props.description: The code API, in the definition's order.

states.description: Interaction states. Empty for a non-interactive component.

variants.description: Variant axes, keyed by axis name.

role.description: The ARIA role or native element, and how it is labeled.

wcag.description: The WCAG success criteria it addresses, each with the reason it applies.

focus.description: Focus behavior and its visible indicator.

aria.description: ARIA state attributes, and any live-region announcement.

content.description: Copy guidance for a writer, per pattern. Absent when the definition carries none.

errorPattern.description: How to write an error message.

emptyPattern.description: How to write an empty state.

dialogPattern.description: How to word the action that confirms a dialog.

metaphorRules.description: When a visual metaphor fits, and when it misleads.

usage.description: When and how to use the component.

dont.description: Practices to avoid, each with its reason.

contentGuidelines.description: Guidance for the text inside the component.

ai.description: The decision surface: whether this component fits a request.

primaryPurpose.description: What the component is for, in one sentence.

avoidWhen.description: The situations it does not fit, and what fits instead.

commonPartners.description: Components it is often used with.

triggerKeywords.description: Words in a request that point to this component.

generationPriority.description: The tiebreaker when several components could serve a request; higher wins.

motion.description: Motion behavior. Absent when the definition carries none.

reduceMotion.description: What changes under a reduced-motion preference.

composition.description: How the component relates to others. Every id list names registered components; `planned` names ones not built yet.

composesWith.description: Components it contains or sits beside.

alternativeTo.description: Components that solve a neighboring problem.

planned.description: Related components not built yet, by the id they would take.

replacesPatterns.description: Hand-built or native patterns it replaces, as prose.
